roles.mandate: Direction, business model, pricing and packaging, focus, economics, and what to stop.

examine: repository configuration, pricing, packaging, and business-model surfaces (config files, billing/plan code, READMEs)
planning artifacts describing direction, scope, and what to stop (epics, specs, features, backlog)
git history of recent strategic and pricing changes
investigationMandate.sufficientGrounding: At least one cited repository path or planning artifact evidencing the current business-model, pricing, or focus surface, plus git history establishing recent strategic change — all resolvable at the pinned revision.

roles.mandate: Reliability, security, payments, privacy, data integrity, delivery risk, and blast radius.

examine: repository source implementing reliability, security, payments, privacy, and data-integrity paths
architecture, configuration, and delivery/release code that governs blast radius
git history of recent changes to those risk-bearing subsystems
investigationMandate.sufficientGrounding: At least one cited repository path in a risk-bearing subsystem (security, payments, data integrity, or delivery) plus git history of recent change to it — all resolvable at the pinned revision.

roles.mandate: Actor journeys, activation, retention, friction, accessibility, and incomplete product loops.

examine: repository source implementing actor-facing flows, activation, retention, and product loops (routes, views, handlers, accessibility markup)
planning artifacts describing user journeys and outcomes (stories, gherkin, specs)
git history of recent changes to those product surfaces
investigationMandate.sufficientGrounding: At least one cited repository path in an actor-facing flow or an incomplete product loop, or a planning artifact describing the journey — resolvable at the pinned revision.

roles.mandate: ICP clarity, organic demand, lifecycle coverage, proof, channel readiness, and bounded experiments.

examine: repository content covering positioning, onboarding, and lifecycle surfaces (landing/marketing code, docs, READMEs, onboarding flows)
planning artifacts describing target customers, outcomes, and bounded experiments
git history of recent lifecycle and positioning changes
investigationMandate.sufficientGrounding: At least one cited repository path or planning artifact evidencing the positioning, onboarding, or lifecycle surface — resolvable at the pinned revision.

roles.mandate: Human operations, billing and contracts, compliance, support load, vendors, and owner bottlenecks.

examine: repository content covering operations, billing, contracts, compliance, and support surfaces (config, scripts, policy docs, vendor integration code)
planning artifacts describing operational decisions, owner bottlenecks, and support load
git history of recent operational and compliance changes
investigationMandate.sufficientGrounding: At least one cited repository path or planning artifact evidencing the operational, billing, compliance, or support surface — resolvable at the pinned revision.

roles.mandate: Evidence reconciliation, conflict sequencing, duplicate merging, and bounded route proposals.

examine: the verified advisor results produced earlier in this cycle
the planning and repository citations those advisor results already resolved
investigationMandate.sufficientGrounding: At least two verified advisor results from the current cycle, each already bound to resolved citations, before any merge or sequence proposal.
